about: choicebench cases (A.2, spec section 10). Labelled cases have one clear answer (good: the option ids judged sensible, why: the reason); equal cases (equal: true) offer options that differ only in name or kind, so any position preference shows. Option names, facts and effects follow mcWorld.ts choiceOptions() and the context choiceContext(); ids as ChoiceOption.id. holds and excludes are filled in by the bench when left out.
